=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:Lines 102-104 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_reject` sends rejection responses without setting a one-second socket timeout.
  WHY: A client that stops reading can block the single-threaded relay indefinitely; all four reviewers rate this a blocker.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:Lines 106-130 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `do_POST` rejects requests before draining a valid, bounded declared body, including when forwarded-header validation fails.
  WHY: A rejected POST whose body is still being sent can result in `BrokenPipeError` instead of the intended HTTP 400.
- tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py:Missing `test_reject_binds_response_write_timeout` (should appear around line 175) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The regression test for `_reject`'s one-second timeout, including the `OSError` path, is absent.
  WHY: CI will not catch a regression in the rejection response timeout; severity disagreement: deepseek and qwen rate this major, while minimax rates it blocker.
- tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py:Missing five body-drain tests | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The body-drain regression tests covering rejected bodies, forwarded-header rejection, bounded reads, deadlines, and timeout reset are absent.
  WHY: CI will not catch regressions in the body-drain behavior; severity disagreement: deepseek rates this major, while minimax rates the missing relay tests blocker.
- README.md:Between lines 1920 and 1922 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The relay documentation paragraph describing body draining and rejection response timeouts is absent.
  WHY: Operators do not see the documented timeout and body-drain behavior for rejection paths.
- README.md:around line 1936-1949 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The README lacks the relay documentation stating that all rejection responses, including GET and CONNECT, use the same one-second socket timeout.
  WHY: Operators do not see the relay rejection timeout guarantee.
- changelog.d/6118-main-ci-green-claude-template-sync.md:Entire file missing | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment for the relay fix and template-sync work is absent.
  WHY: Release-time changelog assembly will omit the entry.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 355-358 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `conditional_cd = False` reset is missing from `_guarded_git_invocations` after the conditional `cd … || exit 1` handling.
  WHY: The parser can retain the wrong working directory and apply the push guard to a worktree the user did not intend.
- .claude/commands/apply-url.md:line 23, line 74 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The command still says the hand-off is “to ship it” rather than “to hand it to the orchestrator.”
  WHY: The wording inaccurately describes the command path; the wiring itself is correct.
- .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:line 12, line 13 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The command lacks the label-presence confirmation step before posting `/reclarify`.
  WHY: The clarify pipeline may not see the `ai:engine-claude` label and can silently fall back to the default engine.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-ai.md:line 1, line 58 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The command still describes `/implement-plan-claude` as an in-session implementation command rather than a hand-off.
  WHY: The wording is misleading, though the command paths are correct.

  WHY: Template changes will not be synchronized automatically, leaving live copies behind and breaking parity.
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:the entire script (does not exist on disk) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  WHY: The automated copy path and CI preparation step cannot run.

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

  WHY: The PR's stated fixes and deliverables are absent, leaving the CI failures and relay regression unaddressed.

- requirement: “For a POST rejected during initial request or forwarded-header validation, the relay waits at most one second to drain a declared body with a short decimal Content-Length of at most MAX_BODY before returning 400.”
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py, method do_POST
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The working tree at lines 106-130 contains no body drain logic whatsoever. The initial rejection block returns `self._reject(400)` directly at line 127 without consuming the request body. The `headers = forwarded_request_headers(self.headers)` call at line 128 runs after the initial rejection, so forwarded-header failures also skip body draining; The working tree's do_POST has the pre-PR structure with no body-drain logic.
- requirement: The PR description states "the 400 response has its own one-second socket timeout even if the drain deadline expires. Malformed or oversized lengths are rejected without draining. All rejection responses, including GET and CONNECT, use the same one-second socket timeout for the response write."
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py, method _reject at line 102
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The `_reject` method at lines 102-104 contains only `self.send_error(status, "Request rejected")` and `self.close_connection = True`. There is no `self.connection.settimeout(1)` call with an `OSError` guard; The `_reject` method at line 102-104 has no `settimeout(1)` call.
